BiblicalUsage: Deep, and the Bible uses it for the speech you cannot understand. Thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, Ezekiel is told, but to the house of Israel. And Isaiah sees a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive, of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
TheologicalSignificance: Depth is not a doctrine, and the word proves it: a language can be too deep to understand and still be no hiding place from God.
